items.title: Lionel Hampton interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: I started out when I was a youngster, at 17 years old I used to be a drummer for Louis Armstrong.

ctx.x: It is an extreme pleasure to have you here. And I’d like to start out and ask you about this, one of your more recent recording efforts here. This is a great effort here and I think the title, “For the Love of Music” really sums up perhaps what a lot of your life has been like, and it must have been interesting to record with fellows like Stevie Wonder. And I think that they were probably really happy to make a record with you.

Yes. I’ll tell you, it was quite an ordeal having these great stars to work with me. Well that’s what I’ve been working with all my life. But I started out when I was a youngster, at 17 years old I used to be a drummer for Louis Armstrong.
